title: Hamiltonian Learning and Certification via Eigenphase Engineering
summary: We study Hamiltonian learning for $k$-local Hamiltonians at large step size, using only forward time evolution at integer multiples of a fixed time interval. For this task, our new technique, which we call eigenphase engineering, achieves Heisenberg-limited learning with a step size that is optimal up to logarithmic factors.
